source_order.result: The official Constitution and the controlling Indian comparison cases were rechecked on 25 August 2026. Foreign systems are used as stable design comparators rather than as volatile political snapshots; no current officeholder, party majority or transient reform proposal is frozen.

pyq_audit.status: Exact wording is retained where held; neutral routed wording and doctrinal solutions are labelled when official keys/models are unavailable.

current_affairs_audit.fact: The official Constitution and the controlling Indian comparison cases were rechecked on 25 August 2026. Foreign systems are used as stable design comparators rather than as volatile political snapshots; no current officeholder, party majority or transient reform proposal is frozen.
current_affairs_audit.caveat: India borrowed constitutional techniques but adapted them to a written, supreme, federal-parliamentary and judicially reviewable Constitution. Comparison must identify function, context and Indian adaptation; the Indian President is not a US President, Rajya Sabha is not a US Senate, and Directive Principles are not an operational copy of Ireland.
